content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: ACTREC is a centre of Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, and the notice writes it as "Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC". A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., which supplies manpower to ACTREC on an outsourced basis, will place the selected Programmer at this centre on contract.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post: Programmer. It will be filled on contract through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. Candidates must meet both the essential qualification and the essential experience below. B. E/ B. Tech / MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Computer Science) or equivalent from Govt. recognized university with at least 60% aggregate marks. Proficient in .NET development with hands-on experience in C#, VB.NET, and the .NET Framework. Strong knowledge of ASP.NET MVC and ASP.NET Core MVC for web application development. Frontend skills including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. Good Understanding of WCF/REST API, IIS configuration. Proficient in SQL Server for database design, queries, and optimization. Familiarity with architecture styles. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. At least 1 year of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using ASP.NET MVC and C#. The age limit is Up to 30 Years, and the notice says it "may be relaxed on experience basis". The notice does not give an "as on" date for working out age. Where a candidate falls in this range depends on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. The contract runs for 6 months and is extendable as per requirement. The selected candidate is engaged on contract through the outsourced contractor, A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., and placed at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification (Advt- OS-A/129/2026).

faq.question: Q1. When is the ACTREC Programmer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The ACTREC Programmer walk-in interview is on Wednesday, 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the ACTREC Programmer walk-in?
faq.answer: Report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. at Meeting Room-2, 3rd floor, Khanolkar Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q3. How many Programmer vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy. The notice advertises the Programmer post without printing a number, so it is counted as one post.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the ACTREC Programmer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. E/ B. Tech / MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Computer Science) or equivalent from a Govt. recognized university, with at least 60% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is needed for the Programmer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 1 year of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using ASP.NET MVC and C#. They also need the .NET, frontend, SQL Server and WCF/REST API skills listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the ACTREC Programmer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is Up to 30 Years, and the notice says it may be relaxed on experience basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of the ACTREC Programmer?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹ 35,000/- p.m. to ₹ 50,000/- p.m. Where a candidate falls in this range depends on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph and scanned copies of your Aadhar Card and PAN CARD. Also bring the ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of your qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ACTREC Programmer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract job through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., an outsourced contractor for manpower services. The contract lasts 6 months and is extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q10. How will the Programmer be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates who meet the requirements may walk in for an interview on 28 October 2026. The notice does not describe any other selection stage.
